script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The text does not say the inheritance is money or that the man speaks in front of the whole crowd.
Calling this a family fight goes beyond the man's request. The text does not say the brothers are fighting.
The text does not establish that the brothers have a dispute; it only gives the man's request.
The passage does not say the man never thinks about his neighbors. It only reports the thoughts he expresses in the parable.
